channel.title: The Hockey News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Hockey News (thehockeynews.com)

item.title: How Barry Trotz And The Predators' Next GM Can Create A Better Path For The Team
item.description: Nashville Predators GM Barry Trotz announced he'll be stepping down, leaving the team's direction wide open. The best direction for the Predators as they pivot from the Trotz Era is to leave the "mushy middle" behind.

item.title: Tragedy Strikes Three Alberta Junior Hockey Players Chasing Their Dreams
item.description: Three teenagers playing for the Southern Alberta Mustangs died Monday in a car accident on their way to practice. Whenever a tragedy of this nature happens, it hits the hockey community very hard.

item.title: Bruins' Joonas Korpisalo Added To Finland's Olympic Team
item.description: Boston Bruins goalie Joonas Korpisalo replaces Buffalo Sabres netminder Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen on Finland's men's Olympic hockey team.

item.title: NHL Rumor Roundup: Maple Leafs' Potential Trade Candidates
item.description: Sitting seven points out of a wild-card berth, the Toronto Maple Leafs are expected to become sellers in the trade market. That could include moving UFA-eligible players and raising questions about core players.

item.title: NHL Hart Trophy Rankings: Is It Already Macklin Celebrini's Time?
item.description: Nathan MacKinnon, Connor McDavid and Nikita Kucherov are once again in the NHL's Hart Trophy conversation, but 19-year-old Macklin Celebrini moves up in this month's top five.

item.title: Reports: Sam Bennett Replaces Anthony Cirelli On Canada's Olympic Team
item.description: Florida Panthers center Sam Bennett replaces injured Tampa Bay lightning center Anthony Cirelli on Team Canada at the Olympics, according to multiple reports.

item.title: Oilers' McDavid Opens Up In Players' Tribune Story: 'I've Wanted To Win My Whole Life. It's Who I Am.'
item.description: From cutting his bachelor party short to addressing criticisms that he has the bubbly personality of a robot, here are some highlights from "Dear Canada."

item.title: The Wraparound: Could Quinn Hughes Earn As Much As Kirill Kaprizov On His Next Contract?
item.description: Emma Lingan, Michael Augello and Adam Kierszenblat discuss Sam Bennett replacing Anthony Cirelli on Team Canada, Quinn Hughes' next contract, Patrik Laine, Zayne Parekh and more

item.title: How The Flyers Should Approach Their Michkov And Tocchet Problem
item.description: Matvei Michkov played a season-low 10:21 of ice time on Saturday, and coach Rick Tocchet told a Flyers podcast that the sophomore did not come into camp in shape. What's the way forward?

item.title: The Pressure Rises On The Oilers' Goaltending Again
item.description: The Oilers' new goalie tandem, Tristan Jarry and Connor Ingram, has had hot moments but struggled in the past week-and-a-half. It's not time to panic, but the pressure's increasing.
